decisions.reason: The compact rotating dumper extends the firm's established construction offer, has its own web page, and has had only one year on the market, so any weak results can still be blamed on start-up effects and dropping it would write off development work.
The articulated dumper builds on core competencies and is publicly presented, so management will defend the investment and keep it while the market ramp-up is still short.

The mine rescue vehicle is far from the core business and carries more risk, but it required substantial specialized investment and is visibly showcased, and niche underground sales cycles are long, so slow sales can be read as temporary and the firm will persist.

The telescopic loader line has several models, which signals heavy investment and visible commitment, so dropping it would expose a major earlier decision as a mistake, making a phase-out within a year very unlikely.
